user_story: As a staff member, I want confirming an already-cancelled booking to return an error so that invalid state transitions are blocked.

positive.title: Confirm a valid booking
steps: Step 1: Log in as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the bookings section.
Step 3: Select a booking with a 'pending' status.

negative.title: Confirm an already-cancelled booking
steps: Step 1: Log in as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the bookings section.
Step 3: Select a booking with a 'cancelled' status.
Step 4: Attempt to click on the 'Confirm' button.
negative.expected_result: An error message is displayed indicating that confirmation of a cancelled booking is not allowed.

edge.title: Attempt to confirm a booking with unsaved changes
steps: Step 1: Log in as a staff member.
Step 2: Navigate to the bookings section.
Step 3: Select a booking and make edits without saving.
Step 4: Attempt to confirm the booking.
edge.expected_result: The system prompts to save changes before confirming or prevents confirmation until changes are saved.
